//: Strict env mode: turbo passes only declared variables to tasks. Locally the config is filled in from .env files, in CI (F0.9) — from the environment only, so the tasks' env contract is declared here. CI is passthrough (doesn't affect the cache hash): Playwright depends on it (forbidOnly, retries, reporter). The contract chain (F1.4) is declared here too: @rondo/api#openapi boots the compiled Nest app in preview mode and writes apps/api/openapi.json (no server, no database), then @rondo/api-client#codegen turns that file into typed sources — both cacheable, with package-relative outputs. Note that a "//" key inside "tasks" is parsed as a task, not a comment.
